items.headline: Manchester United complete £70m signing of Carlos Baleba from Brighton
items.summary: Cameroon midfielder Carlos Baleba joins on five-year deal, with option of further year. Fee £65m guaranteed plus £5m add-ons. Baleba currently injured with ankle issue.

items.headline: Baleba injury update: Ankle problem to sideline midfielder until mid-September
items.summary: Carlos Baleba picked up ankle injury in pre-season. Expected return by mid-September ahead of Manchester City match on 13 September.

items.headline: Baleba completes Man United's £150m+ midfield overhaul with Tielemans and Santos
items.summary: Third midfield signing of summer. Baleba joins Youri Tielemans and Andrey Santos (£111m combined) in midfield rebuild under Michael Carrick.
